alice (DevEx): quick note — onboarding feedback: users report opaque errors in quickstart when API returns structured hints. We should standardize what SDKs expose so sample apps can render helpful UI.

ben (SDK): can you share an example payload?

alice (DevEx): from logs: POST /v1/embeddings -> 422 {"error":"invalid_input", "details": ["prompt too long"], "suggestion": "truncate to 2048 tokens"} but SDK surfaces `Error: 422` only.

carol (sample-app): result: UI shows "Unknown error, try again". Users have to dig to logs to see truncation hint. Bad first impression.

ben (SDK): proposal: SDK error object should include these string fields: `code` (ERR_VALIDATION, ERR_AUTH, ERR_QUOTA, etc.), `status` (422), `message` (human message), `hints` (array of strings), `retryable` (bool). Keep it small and consistent across languages.

dave (infra): we'll add `error.code` and `error.hints` to API responses. Backwards compat: they will be optional for a release cycle.

eileen (PM): please include copy guidance: when `code==ERR_VALIDATION` and hints mention truncation, quickstart should show a small inline tip with a one-click truncate helper. Improves completion for new users.

ben (SDK): implementation note: Node/Python/Go will expose a typed Error subclass with properties: `.code`, `.status`, `.message`, `.hints` (string[]), `.retryable`. Also add a small utility `shouldRetry(err)` that applies policy: 5xx/ERR_RATE_LIMIT -> true, ERR_AUTH/ERR_VALIDATION/ERR_QUOTA -> false.

alice (DevEx): test ask: add e2e that mocks 422 with suggestion and asserts UI shows suggestion.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app quickstart e2e failing on branch fix/error-shape — 1 failing test (missing suggestion rendering).

carol (sample-app): I'll patch quickstart to consume `.hints[0]` if present and show a compact notice. Will also avoid auto-refresh on non-retryable auth errors. PR incoming.

ben (SDK): I'll add typed error classes + `shouldRetry` and a migration guide in SDK changelogs.

eileen (PM): I'll update the onboarding checklist and add a line in docs: "If you see ERR_VALIDATION with truncation hint, try shortening the prompt or use the helper".

alice (DevEx): thanks — small follow-up: surface `error.code` in Console error inspector to help debugging.

dave (infra): on backlog; low effort.

alice (DevEx): wrapping up — timeline: ben & carol PRs this week, infra toggles optional, docs + tests next sprint. Will re-open if CI still complains. :thumbsup:
